page.layout: One printed page, single column of verse and text, with a running head at the top and page number at the top right; a decorative woodcut band divides the page; a woodcut initial opens the final poem. No marginal notes.

p.i: Sed qui Beza tuis fauet Camœnis,
Qui te semper amat, bonosque vates,
Non dicit lepidum esse vel venustum,

main_text.head: AD THEOPHILVM QVATIGRANVM TEMPENSEM AMICISSIMVM, & Ecclesiasten diligentissimum.

page.notes: Decorative woodcut initial "O" at the start of the final poem; its letter is read as O. The running head and page number are as printed. The signature "G 2" is printed at the foot right.
